## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector-level participation (Energy, Financials, Industrials positive) but leadership is narrow into Energy and there is megacap divergence (MSFT, AMZN showing 1W vs 1M mismatch).

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Energy leads: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND — Energy: 10/10 positive. Technology also showing pockets of strength: LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AMD (1W: +6.42% | 1M: +2.68%) ABOVE TREND, INTU (1W: +6.28% | 1M: +17.26%) ABOVE TREND — Technology: 13/24 positive. Financials constructive: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND — Financials: 12/20 positive.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Consumer Staples lagging: MNST (1W: -49.62% | 1M: -54.45%) BELOW TREND, WMT (1W: +3.06% | 1M: +0.28%) ABOVE TREND (mixed) — Consumer Staples: 3/14 positive. Consumer Discretionary weak: AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND — Consumer Discretionary: 5/14 positive. Materials modestly soft: FCX (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION — Materials: 4/11 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND, COP (1W: +7.80% | 1M: +12.35%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND — Leadership: Narrow (5/5 Energy).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: MNST (1W: -49.62% | 1M: -54.45%) BELOW TREND, CSCO (1W: -8.03% | 1M: +1.84%) CORRECTION, AVGO (1W: -8.13% | 1M: +4.95%) CORRECTION, AMAT (1W: -5.93% | 1M: -9.58%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND — Weakness concentrated in select staples/tech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +14.54% | 1M: +14.23%) ABOVE TREND, PSX (1W: +13.67% | 1M: +19.09%) ABOVE TREND; watch divergence among large caps — MSFT (1W: -0.92% | 1M: +23.51%) CORRECTION and AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION signal tactical dispersion.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but constructive pockets; NVDA (1W: +0.54% | 1M: +8.56%) ABOVE TREND, LRCX (1W: +6.75% | 1M: +3.55%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -2.28% | 1M: -8.12%) BELOW TREND — Technology: 13/24 positive; overall internal rotation with leadership concentrated in semiconductors and select software.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Stable-to-positive: JPM (1W: +1.49% | 1M: +5.74%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +1.13% | 1M: +3.22%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +0.64% | 1M: -0.09%) RECOVERY — Financials: 12/20 positive; supports cyclical/value tilt.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Patchy; JNJ (1W: +0.43% | 1M: +4.15%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +0.11% | 1M: +8.43%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND — Healthcare: 9/17 positive; watch headline-driven idiosyncratic moves.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor Energy and select Financials given narrow Energy leadership and positive sector breadth; reduce exposure to weak staples and names showing clear BELOW TREND action (MNST, HD). Style: Cyclical/Value favored while monitoring megacap dispersion and tech-pocket strength.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +7.20% | 1M: +8.78%) ABOVE TREND, WMB (1W: +6.82% | 1M: +0.63%) ABOVE TREND — strong energy catalysts. BEARISH: MNST (1W: -49.62% | 1M: -54.45%) BELOW TREND, HD (1W: -4.71% | 1M: -2.63%) BELOW TREND, AMZN (1W: -4.31% | 1M: +5.11%) CORRECTION — monitor execution/earnings flow.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Energy (10/10 positive) and Financials (12/20 positive) for cyclical continuation. BEARISH: Consumer Staples (3/14 positive) and Consumer Discretionary (5/14 positive) for relative weakness.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
MPC break/hold near recent highs (1W strength) will signal continuation; NVDA above 1M trend band (ABOVE TREND) confirms tech participation; AAPL failing to reclaim short-term resistance keeps large-cap risk elevated.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
WMB (+55): Williams (1W: +6.82% | 1M: +0.63%) ABOVE TREND — news and price confirming accumulation. FCX (+50): Freeport (1W: -4.50% | 1M: +13.54%) CORRECTION — bullish headlines but short-term pullback = distribution risk to monitor. HON (+50): Honeywell (1W: -4.69% | 1M: +3.68%) CORRECTION — orders strength in headlines but price showing short-term exhaustion.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
UNH (-90): UnitedHealth (1W: -1.31% | 1M: -5.11%) BELOW TREND — sentiment and price aligned, idiosyncratic risk. META (-50): Meta (1W: -0.38% | 1M: -11.24%) BELOW TREND — legal headlines confirm weakness. BA (-40): Boeing (1W: -1.17% | 1M: +8.09%) CORRECTION — negative headlines amid 1M strength = watch for follow-through.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with a Cyclical/Value tilt given Energy and Financials strength. MPC (1W: +19.19% | 1M: +16.21%) ABOVE TREND and XOM (1W: +4.61% | 1M: +9.70%) ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow Energy leadership and megacap divergence (MSFT CORRECTION, AMZN CORRECTION, AAPL BELOW TREND) amid mixed news flow (UNH headline-driven downside).
